pages.text:
The news system broadcasts important server events to interested players.
|
|SYNTAX:
|  news                 - Toggle news on/off
|  news on              - Turn news on
|  news off             - Turn news off
|  news show            - List available news categories
|  news status          - Show your current news settings
|  news <category>     - Toggle a specific news category
|
|ALIASES: broadcast, system
|
|CATEGORIES:
|  on       - Main news toggle (must be on to receive anything)
|  deaths   - Player deaths and quests completed
|  logins   - Player login announcements
|  levels   - Player level ups and advancements
|  consent  - Consent-based activities
|  quests   - Quest-related announcements
|
|By default, new characters receive all news categories. You can customize
|which announcements you see by toggling individual categories on and off.
|Use 'news status' to see your current settings.
